generatedFrom.query: SELECT world_name, entity_id, entity->'metadata'->'display'->>'title' AS title, entity->>'timestamp' AS deployed_ms, size, jsonb_array_length(entity->'pointers') AS parcels FROM world_scenes WHERE world_name IN ('slaythesteps.dcl.eth','cleantheclub.dcl.eth','fortunes.dcl.eth','fastlane.dcl.eth','skychaser.dcl.eth','alienscrapyard.dcl.eth','flagtag.dcl.eth')
notes: deployedAt is the deployment entity's own `timestamp` (ms since epoch) — when the creator deployed the scene, not when our mirror first saw it.

parcels is jsonb_array_length(entity->'pointers'). The mirror's flat `parcels` column stores each parcel's x and y as separate elements, so it reads exactly twice this number; the pointer count is the parcel count.
sizeBytes is the mirror's `size` column for that deployment.
`deployer` is empty on every one of these mirror rows, so no deployer, studio or team is recorded here and none is displayed.
titles are the deployment entity's own display title, including the one that is a template leftover (Circus_Fortune_Teller) — it is not tidied up.
repoPath and botManifest are provenance links, not sources: they point at the local harness copies of the same games (~/one/rig/play, ~/projects/dcl-scene-bots).
